There was one case of a child who was a victim of trafficking. And this child had been identified and cared for. It wasn't a case of enforced disappearance. The child was a victim of trafficking. And together with the language of Indigenous Peoples, I should point out that Indigenous Peoples in Gabon live in coexistence with the Bantus. Perhaps we need to come back to this. Indigenous peoples speak several languages. And the Bantu, the others, live side by side on a daily basis. There's no language barrier between Indigenous peoples and the Bantu. They speak the same language. Simply, where in Walentem, Fan will be spoken, Indigenous peoples will speak Fan. Even if they are Baka people, they'll speak Fan. And I would go even further to say that many of them speak French because French is the national language.
